about: Supplier dossier for the fully documented suppliers (detail = full). Built by scripts/build_dossier.py from the data package and the Sunday release.

fields.reading: situation labels the agent absorbs at setup (reader agent + phrase lists), each with its quote and source
fields.company: register facts (supplier_intel): owner, size, equity, credit index (higher = riskier) now and a year ago
fields.our_payments: how we paid its invoices in the last 12 months: mean days late, share paid late, we_pay_late flag
fields.quality: latest scorecard and supplier-caused quality notifications in the last 12 months
fields.dependency: parts it supplies to us and where it is our only active source
fields.costing: should-cost coverage and past negotiations (context only: they do not predict where it stops)
fields.review: for the team: status auto|checked|corrected and a note
